title: Tim Cook says Apple's iPhone X sales were a Super Bowl victory - even if you wanted the team to win by 'a few more points' (AAPL)
text: Tim Cook says Apple's iPhone X sales were a Super Bowl victory — even if you wanted the team to win by 'a few more points' (AAPL) By Troy Wolverton May 1, 2018, 5:49 pm 23 pts Apple's new iPhone X outsold other iPhone models in the company's latest quarter. The new model was the best selling model every week in the quarter, company CEO Tim Cook said. The results should be a relief for investors and analysts who have been worried about how well the pricey new model is…
